content: We have presented a new dataset for political stance detection called x-stance. The dataset extends over a broad range of topics and issues regarding national Swiss politics. This diversity of topics opens up an opportunity to further study multi-target learning. Moreover, being partly Swiss Standard German, partly French and Italian, the dataset promotes a multilingual approach to stance detection.
